title: Interview Prep
description: Voice-enabled AI mock interviews from your CV and job ad, ending in structured feedback.

screens.title: Interview setup
screens.description: Configure an interview session by providing the candidate's CV, job description, and optional company overview before starting the interview.

screens.title: Interactive interview session
screens.description: Practise realistic interview questions through an interactive interview experience with an AI interviewer, candidate responses, spoken questions, and interview controls.

screens.title: AI interview reflection
screens.description: Review structured post-interview feedback covering observations, strengths, communication, growth opportunities, overall impression, and the next area to focus on.

screens.title: InterviewPrep REST API
screens.description: The ASP.NET Core backend exposes documented REST endpoints for creating and managing interview sessions, generating questions, submitting answers, and completing interviews.

screens.title: Project structure
screens.description: The repository separates the backend API, application, domain, infrastructure, tests, and Next.js client into a layered full-stack solution following Clean Architecture.

title: Spaza Stock Manager
description: Role-based inventory system for spaza shops: stock, suppliers, transactions, low-stock alerts.

screens.title: Role-based login
screens.description: The application begins with a role-based login screen supporting Owner, Cashier, and Stock Clerk demo users.

screens.title: Operational dashboard
screens.description: The main inventory dashboard provides an operational overview of stock activity and inventory status for day-to-day retail management.

screens.title: Inventory items
screens.description: Manage inventory items through a searchable data grid with supplier filtering, stock visibility, pricing, paging, and item maintenance actions.

screens.title: Stock transactions
screens.description: Track inventory movement through recent activity and transaction history with movement type, dates, quantities, references, and notes.

screens.title: Low-stock monitoring
screens.description: Monitor products that require replenishment and identify stock gaps using thresholds, severity filtering, and restock actions.

screens.title: Supplier management
screens.description: Manage supplier relationships and inventory sources through searchable supplier records with contact, email, and status information.

screens.title: Inventory REST API
screens.description: The ASP.NET Core backend exposes inventory operations through documented REST endpoints for inventory, items, and stock transactions.

screens.title: Project structure
screens.description: The repository separates the API, application, client, domain, infrastructure, and test projects into a layered full-stack solution.

title: Simple Store
description: Full-stack e-commerce store: React storefront, Node.js API, shopping cart and Swagger docs.

screens.title: Simple Store repository
screens.description: The GitHub repository contains the complete full-stack Simple Store application, separating the React frontend from the Node.js and TypeScript backend.

screens.title: Shopping cart
screens.description: Manage products added to the cart with quantity controls, item removal, product details, and a dynamically calculated total.

screens.title: Product catalogue
screens.description: Browse available products loaded from the backend API, with product images, descriptions, prices, and add-to-cart actions.

screens.title: Simple Store API
screens.description: Interactive Swagger documentation for the Node.js and Express REST API, providing endpoints for products and shopping cart operations.

title: SmartWheel
description: Five riddles decide your prize on a reward wheel, with server-side scoring and daily cooldown.

screens.title: SmartWheel
screens.description: The main SmartWheel screen introduces the reward wheel and lets the user start the game by selecting Spin the Wheel.

screens.title: Player identity
screens.description: When the user starts the game, they are asked to enter their email address so the application can identify or create their player account.

screens.title: Riddle challenge
screens.description: After entering their identity, the user completes five riddles. Their answers are submitted to the backend and used to calculate their score.

screens.title: Spin result
screens.description: Once the riddle challenge is completed, the backend uses the user's score to determine the prize and the exact wheel segment where the wheel should stop.

screens.title: Daily spin restriction
screens.description: After receiving a reward, attempting to play again before the 24-hour cooldown has passed is blocked and the user is asked to return the following day.

screens.title: SmartWheel REST API
screens.description: The ASP.NET Core backend exposes documented endpoints for resolving player identity, processing spins, checking player status, and providing the application's API contract.

screens.title: SmartWheel repository
screens.description: The GitHub repository contains the complete full-stack solution, separating the API, application logic, infrastructure, and React client into a layered architecture.

title: EventReserve
description: Create events, manage reservations and track bookings with a responsive React and .NET app.

screens.title: Event management
screens.description: Create and manage events through the platform's responsive event management workflow.

screens.title: Reservations
screens.description: Users can create and manage reservations associated with scheduled events.

screens.title: Booking management
screens.description: Reservation information can be tracked and managed through the application's booking workflow.

screens.title: Validation
screens.description: Validation helps keep event and reservation information consistent throughout the booking process.

screens.title: API integration
screens.description: The React frontend communicates with the ASP.NET Core API through the application's RESTful integration.

title: Course Enrollment App
description: Course platform: register, log in with JWT, browse courses and manage your own course list.

screens.title: Course Enrollment landing page
screens.description: The public landing page introduces the Makufundwe course platform and provides entry points for browsing courses or creating an account.

screens.title: Create account
screens.description: New users create a student account by providing their name, email address, and password before accessing the course platform.

screens.title: User login
screens.description: Registered users authenticate through the ASP.NET Core API before accessing the protected course functionality.

screens.title: Available Courses
screens.description: Authenticated users browse the course catalogue, search for courses, and add courses to their personal learning list.

screens.title: My Courses
screens.description: Courses selected from the available catalogue are displayed in the user's personal course area.

screens.title: Course Enrollment REST API
screens.description: Swagger provides interactive documentation for the backend API supporting authentication, courses, students, and enrollment operations.

screens.title: Course Enrollment App repository
screens.description: The GitHub repository separates the Blazor client, API, application logic, domain model, and infrastructure into a layered Clean Architecture solution.
